ValidationRule.description: If Core IO is checked on an Agency opportunity, Intro Call Scheduled Date/Time must be populated. Excludes System Admins.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.Name= "Agency"&& $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator"&& Core_IO__c = TRUE && ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")&& ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISBLANK( Intro_Call_Scheduled_Date_Time__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before closing this opportunity, please enter a value in the Intro Call Schedule Date/Time field
